title: crataegus crus-galli var. pachyphylla
intro: Crataegus crus-galli var. pachyphylla, commonly known as a specific variety of hawthorn, is a plant species native to certain regions. It is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, such as reducing cardiovascular disease risk, lowering blood pressure, and improving cardiac function. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus crus-galli var. pachyphylla include acting as a vasodilator, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can contribute to its cardiovascular protective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
